text:
alex: PTAL on PR #4321 — addressed the review comments and split the flaky test into a separate file. I added a small smoke script and a note in the PR description. CI is mostly green but one e2e is still failing intermittently. Can we get a canary slot tomorrow morning? I'm planning to target staging-canary.

maria: thanks — will take a look in ~30m. which e2e is flaky?

alex: `batching_integration::retry_backoff` — I added a retry and a comment explaining the non-determinism. Locally it passes on my machine, CI failure looks infra-related (timeout).

sam: i'll try to repro locally now, if it's infra we can skip that test in CI for this merge and track separately.

jen: FYI ops: canary queue opens at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Please add `canary-window: 09-10` to PR body and @ops in the thread to reserve.

alex: done — updated PR body with `canary-window: 09-10` and smoke script path `./scripts/smoke/canary_check.sh`. triggered CI rerun. ping @maria @sam for final eyes.

ci-bot: CI started for commit abc123 — 2/7 checks running (unit, linters).

maria: quick nit: docs.md has two small typos, leaving an inline comment. otherwise looks clean.

alex: fixed docs typos and pushed the change. PTAL @maria @sam :pray:

maria: LGTM from docs side.

sam: i reproduced the flaky e2e locally, the new retry fixed it — ran 5x, all green. LGTM.

jen: canary slot reserved, tagging merge on successful CI. :thumbsup: please put a short rollback plan in the PR description (one-liner).

alex: added rollback plan to PR: "rollback by reverting the merge commit and triggering canary rollback job". CI finished and all checks passed.

ci-bot: All checks passed. Merge scheduled.

alex: Merged and canary is running. i'll watch telemetry for the next hour and post results here.

sam: noted — I'll stand by for latency/regression callouts.

alex: first 30m look good, smoke script returned success, no CPU/latency regressions in CloudWatch panels. closing follow-up.

jen: thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
